shared.zh: 主语：主干里句子说的是谁、是什么，按中心词对照；每句都有
shared.en: subject: in the skeleton, who or what the sentence is about, checked by its head word; every sentence has one

shared.zh: 谓语：主干里主语做什么、怎么样，立着的词一个不差；每句都有
shared.en: verb: in the skeleton, what the subject does or is, every standing word of it; every sentence has one

shared.zh: 宾语：主干里动作落到的东西，按中心词对照
shared.en: object: in the skeleton, what the action lands on, checked by its head word

shared.zh: 表语：主干里系动词后面说明主语的成分，按中心词对照
shared.en: complement: in the skeleton, what follows a linking verb about the subject, checked by its head word

shared.zh: 介词短语：折成一块，挂到它修饰的词上
shared.en: prepositional phrase: folded into one piece, hung on the word it modifies

shared.zh: 定语从句：折成一块，挂到它修饰的词上
shared.en: relative clause: folded into one piece, hung on the word it modifies

shared.zh: 读者：标出主干，把修饰成分折到它修饰的词上
shared.en: the reader: marks the skeleton, folds each modifier onto the word it modifies

shared.zh: 这款游戏教什么、学完能亲手做成什么，不写关卡数
shared.en: what the game teaches and what the player ends up able to do, not how many levels

shared.zh: 几套托盘：每套是一串元件，按托盘上的先后排；关卡用其中一套，托盘上的元件在带来它或搭出它的那一关之后可用。不写时每关拿到见过的所有元件
shared.en: the trays: each a list of parts in the order it shows them; a level plays with one, and a part on it is usable after the level that brings it in or builds it. Without, every level holds every part it has met

about.zh: 几个元件合起来是一个新概念
about.en: parts that are one new idea together

about.zh: 这一关带来的成分或结构
about.en: the roles and constructions the level brings in

shared.zh: 这一关（这个任务）用的托盘；游戏只有一套托盘时不用写
shared.en: the tray this level (task) plays with; a game of one tray need not say

shared.zh: 新东西第一次出现时只用它一个也算一关：它的用法抽象在哪里
shared.en: a new part may have a level that only uses it: what is abstract about its use

shared.zh: 任务的 id：整款游戏里唯一，玩家存下的板跟着它走（只有一个任务的关通常就用关的 id）
shared.en: the task’s id, unique in the game; what a player keeps of it goes by it (a level’s one task usually has the level’s id)

shared.zh: 这个任务的名字，写在任务条上（一关只有一个任务时不显示）
shared.en: the task’s name on the strip of tasks (not shown when the level has one task)

shared.zh: 句子里的一段词，出现不止一次时写 #n（change#2）
shared.en: words as they stand in the sentence, #n for the n-th of several (change#2)

shared.zh: 折成的结构：标出一种结构的块
shared.en: the construction it is folded as: a block marking one

shared.zh: 挂在别的词（键）上时，那样挂是什么意思
shared.en: what hanging it on another word (the key) would mean

shared.zh: 主干的每个成分（标出它的块）是句子里的哪段词
shared.en: the words of each role of the skeleton, by the block marking it

shared.zh: 标成这个成分、还立着的那几个词（小写）标错时说什么；* 是这句话根本没有这个成分
shared.en: what to say when these standing words (lower case) are marked as it; * when the sentence has no such role

shared.zh: 已经折好、拆不开的块（答案里的折）
shared.en: folds already made and fixed in place (folds of the answer)

shared.zh: 依次做的任务，最后一个通过就通过这一关
shared.en: the tasks done in turn; passing the last passes the level

shared.why: a block is a piece of pieces.json (the strip editor’s), standing for a mark
a fold is folded as a block of pieces.json marking a construction
the roles are the blocks of pieces.json marking a role, each to its words
a misreading is said of a block of pieces.json marking a role
